title: Ask MetaFilter, But TRAINS
content: Do you feel emotionally fulfilled by a good timetable and a smooth departure? Then you'll want to hop on this Ask MetaFilter question about kid-friendly, train-centric trips outside the U.S. Of course you don't have to be a kid to enjoy it or mdonley's compelling case for experiencing Italy's train system, or any of the other global stops on this global adventure! Just enjoy the view!
author: Brandon Blatcher
